items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Elmer James was another very good bass player, a very --

ctx.x: Yeah. I remember when Elmer James was there. But I know the horns, you see. And Jimmy Harrison was on trombone with him for a while.
That's who Chick had for the four horns. And then, of course, the rhythm, he had Bobby Johnson on the guitar. He always did have him. No, Truehart. He had Truehart.
